name: Tickety – Sell Tickets and Manage Events
author: Nxtapps

sections.description:
Tickety gives you a focused way to create events, sell digital tickets, and manage guest entry from WordPress. Create ticket tiers, connect checkout to WooCommerce, send QR passes to ticket holders, and verify tickets at the door.

Whether you are running a workshop, a venue program, a community gathering, or a multi-tier event, Tickety keeps the path from event setup to entry simple and organized.

Create events your way

Build event pages with the details guests need, including dates, times, venue information, descriptions, and featured images. Publish an event directory or present events through your own WordPress pages.

Sell tickets with WooCommerce

Offer free, Standard, VIP, or custom ticket tiers with capacity limits and live availability. Tickety uses WooCommerce for cart, checkout, orders, and payment gateways, so your existing WooCommerce setup remains the source of truth for payments.

Generate digital QR passes

Issue a QR pass for each eligible ticket and send group passes to the buyer by email. Ticket holders can keep their pass ready for quick entry, while organizers can verify passes from a public verification page.

Keep ticket holders organized

Collect ticket-holder details during checkout, support guest purchases, and let signed-in customers reuse saved friends and family profiles when assigning tickets.

Deliver a polished event experience

Use the public event directory, flexible event-card layouts, and light, dark, or automatic color modes to match the experience to your site. The responsive interface works across desktop and mobile screens.

Features

  • Create and publish event pages with date, time, venue, address, image, and description details.
  • Offer free, Standard, VIP, and custom ticket tiers.
  • Set ticket capacity and keep availability synchronized with WooCommerce stock.
  • Support guest and registered-customer checkout.
  • Collect ticket-holder information and assign tickets to saved friends and family profiles.
  • Generate QR passes locally without an external QR service.
  • Email group QR passes to customers after eligible orders.
  • Verify tickets through a public verification page.
  • Publish an event directory with configurable ordering, card count, and card information.
  • Choose light, dark, or automatic frontend color modes.
  • Choose Flat or Spotlight ticket-card layouts.

WooCommerce is only required for checkout, payment processing, ticket orders, and ticket-product inventory. Event setup and the Tickety dashboard remain available without WooCommerce.

Third-Party Libraries

Tickety includes:

  • flatpickr 4.6.13, MIT License, https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr
  • endroid/qr-code and its Composer dependencies. Their license files are included in vendor/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nxt-tickets-events folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Tickety.
  3. If you want to sell tickets, install and activate WooCommerce.
  4. Open Tickety in the WordPress dashboard and create an event.
  5. Configure the Tickety email under WooCommerce > Settings > Emails.
sections.faq:
Can I install Tickety without WooCommerce?

Yes. Tickety installs and provides event management without WooCommerce. The Orders page explains when WooCommerce is needed for checkout, payments, and ticket orders.

Does Tickety process payments?

No. WooCommerce and its configured payment gateways process checkout and payment. Tickety issues passes from eligible WooCommerce orders.

Are QR codes generated locally?

Yes. Tickety bundles an open-source QR-code library and does not require an external QR service.

Can guests purchase tickets?

Yes. Guest buyers enter the required ticket-holder information during checkout.
